why: owner 26 Nov: the addon sometimes uses a lot of CPU: two OnUpdate fixers ran every frame over every line we wrote

ops.old:
local fixer = CreateFrame("Frame")
    fixer:SetScript("OnUpdate", function()
        if InCombatLockdown and InCombatLockdown() then
            return -- 1.1.1: nothing is touched in combat
        end
ops.new:
local fixer = CreateFrame("Frame")
    local acc = 0
    fixer:SetScript("OnUpdate", function(_, el)
        -- 1.1.5: twenty times a second, not every frame (the CPU the owner saw, 26 Nov)
        if el then
            acc = acc + el
            if acc < 0.05 then
                return
            end
            acc = 0
        end
        if InCombatLockdown and InCombatLockdown() then
            return -- 1.1.1: nothing is touched in combat
        end
